messages:
Maya: Kicking off smallwave 5% in ap-south now. DeployBot started. Keep an eye on 502s + tail latency. Change window until 10:40Z. I'm oncall.
DeployBot: [bot] Rollout started: id=sw-20260321-01, target=5%, region=ap-south, version=runtime-v2.14. Deployed to 3 hosts. Link: https://deploys/redwood/sw-20260321-01
Raj: Confirming pinned runtime/variant and fallback policy? Recommend auto-fallback to runtime-v2.13 if errors >0.3% sustained for 3m.
Sam: Also confirm kv-cache warmup: are we preloading hot prefixes for this wave? if not, we might see p95 bumps.
Lina: Can we add a temporary pin rule? If error rate >0.5% or 5xx spike, we hold and notify SRE.
Emma: Agree with Lina. Threshold proposal: errs >0.5% OR median latency >180ms for 3m -> hold.
DeployBot: Metrics snapshot (60s): errors=0.12%, median=120ms, p95=260ms, 502s=0. Telemetry: https://telemetry/redwood/sw-20260321-01
Maya: OK on thresholds. I'll call STOP if any 502 spike >3 in 1m or sustained errs>0.5%. Sam, can you watch kv-cache?
Sam: watching. Running `kubectl logs -l roll=sw-20260321-01 --tail=100` and `redis-cli info` on the cache nodes.
OpsBot: Alert: small uptick in p95 for one host: host-12 p95=520ms, others normal. Investigating.
Raj: Host-12 is on the older kernel patch; recommend draining host-12 from the canary pool now.
Maya: Drain suggested. @DeployBot execute drain host-12 for canary pool.
DeployBot: Executing drain: draining host-12, shifting its ~0.2% traffic back to stable. New canary traffic: ~4.8%.
Lina: Good. Keep holding at 5% until we confirm p95 across all hosts <320ms for 5m.
Emma: +1
DeployBot: HOLD: rollout paused at ~4.8% as requested by Maya. Canary ID=sw-20260321-01. Reason: host p95 spike. No rollback initiated. Ops oncall notified.
Maya: Tagging this for a short postmortem if it repeats, but no rollback immediately. Re-eval in 10m. Thanks all.
